stories.title: Tropical Storm Lala floods Midwest, targets Hawaii under hurricane warning
new_facts: Storm is already lashing the Big Island with wind and rain, not merely forecast.
Forecasters warn of up to 25 inches of rain and life-threatening mudslides; off-grid residents urged to evacuate.
Separate Midwest flooding tied to same weather system, with Iowa River rising.
Hawaii declared state of emergency; Lala could be first hurricane to hit Big Island since 1871.
Hurricane warning issued for Hawaiian Islands as Tropical Storm Lala approaches.
stories.line: Tropical Storm Lala is flooding the Midwest and approaching Hawaii under hurricane warning, with the Big Island facing heavy rain and wind.

stories.title: Massive egg recall issued for salmonella in U.S. south and southwest
new_facts: FDA elevated recall of ~1.6m dozen Texas eggs to highest-risk level amid salmonella outbreak sickening ~100 people.
stories.line: Salmonella contamination has prompted a recall of eggs across southern U.S. states; consumers should check their cartons.

stories.title: Parasite outbreak exposes gaps in U.S. food safety system
stories.line: Cyclospora parasite contaminated U.S. food supply despite safety oversight, sickening thousands across multiple states.

stories.title: Bonnie Tyler dead at 75
new_facts: Establishes story: Bonnie Tyler's coffin brought home, fans line Welsh village streets to bid farewell
Adds real name Gaynor Hopkins, age 75, death in Portugal hospital July 8, prior induced coma after intestinal surgery, funeral Monday

stories.title: Trump pushes Navy to redesign warship to his specifications
new_facts: Specifies redesign detail: moving command tower closer to ship's middle on Ford-class carriers.
Navy considering major redesign of new aircraft carriers to resemble WWII-era ships per Trump's preference; could cost billions.
stories.line: Trump is pushing the Navy to redesign a major warship class to match his preferences, potentially costing billions.
